prompt: Objective: respond to a rival office-cleaning firm that cut prices 15%. What you've learned: we've lost 6% of contracts in four months. Latest finding: the contracts lost were mostly single-office clients. What is the best next step?

options.text: Estimate the cost of matching the 15% cut
options.feedback: That jumps to a response before knowing what the losses are worth.

options.text: Check what the lost contracts were worth and who's next
options.feedback: Right. We know who is leaving. Next is what they are worth and whether bigger clients are next.

options.text: Survey single-office clients on why they prefer the rival's offer
options.feedback: Their reason is likely price. What matters more is the value at stake and whether it spreads.

options.text: Compare our service ratings with the rival's
options.feedback: Secondary. First size what the losses are worth.

explanation: The losses are single-office clients. Before responding, size what they were worth and whether larger clients are at risk.
